scope: Actual WindowsIntel/WindowsIntelPAE/WindowsIntel32e read with physical and explicit swap BufferDataLayers over synthetic page tables. Resident/transition/prototype flags, fixed swap bits and indices, unaligned/cross-page reads, upper-level software entries, missing attachments, backing and table holes are covered. Synthetic adapters do not establish all scanner mapping/chunk/padding or full architecture/platform/exception/resource contracts. Reference swap reads intentionally preserve the pinned offset semantics.
